paragraphs.text: A language with two thousand speakers, all of them over sixty, is in danger however many dictionaries exist. What matters is whether children hear it every day.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: One island tried nurseries where only the old language is spoken. Children learn it quickly, but they answer their parents in the national language unless the parents also use it at home.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Written material helps in a different way. Road signs and local news in the language tell speakers that it belongs in public life, not only at the kitchen table.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Success is slow to see. The island counts speakers every ten years, and the first rise came twenty years after the nurseries opened, when the first pupils had children of their own.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: Road signs and local news in the language tell speakers that it belongs in public life
items.prompt: the role of the language outside the family

explanation.en: Signs and news show the language belongs in public life — paragraph C.
explanation.kk: Жол белгілері мен жаңалық тілдің қоғамда бар екенін көрсетеді — C абзацы.
explanation.ru: Указатели и новости показывают, что язык живёт публично — абзац C.

items.quote: the first rise came twenty years after the nurseries opened
items.prompt: how long it took before results could be measured

explanation.en: The first rise came twenty years later — paragraph D.
explanation.kk: Алғашқы өсім — жиырма жылдан кейін, D абзацы.
explanation.ru: Первый рост — через двадцать лет, абзац D.

items.quote: What matters is whether children hear it every day
items.prompt: what really decides whether a language survives

explanation.en: What decides is whether children hear it daily — paragraph A.
explanation.kk: Балалар тілді күн сайын еститіні шешеді — A абзацы.
explanation.ru: Решает, слышат ли язык дети каждый день — абзац A.

items.quote: they answer their parents in the national language unless the parents also use it at home
items.prompt: a limit of teaching the language to small children

explanation.en: Children answer in the national language — the limit is in paragraph B.
explanation.kk: Балалар мемлекеттік тілде жауап береді — шектеу, B абзацы.
explanation.ru: Дети отвечают на государственном языке — ограничение, абзац B.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Which paragraph contains the following information? Write the correct letter, A–D. NB You may use any letter more than once.
